Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The problem with conventional platforms lies in their centralized architecture and reliance on intermediaries. When a platform blocks your account or imposes fees, you're at their mercy. With a sovereign digital commerce stack, you own the infrastructure, not a stranger's platform. You're not renting a service, you're owning the technology. What You Need Before You Deploy

To deploy this infrastructure, you'll need a digital product to sell, a GitHub account for hosting, a Cloudflare account for CDN and security, a Supabase account for order storage, and a NOWPayments account for automatic crypto payment processing. You'll also need to set up a Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 account for file delivery. Don't worry about technical expertise; these tools are user-friendly and have extensive documentation. You can start with the Sovereign Starter Stack and scale up to the Edge Commerce Stack once your business grows.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to integrate NOWPayments with your Supabase order storage account. This will enable automatic crypto payment processing and real-time order updates. Next, you'll need to configure Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate file delivery from Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. This will ensure seamless delivery of your digital products to customers. With this setup, you can sell digital products without worrying about manual payment processing or file delivery.
You own the infrastructure, not a stranger's platform.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

To go live, you'll need to deploy your GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages site and configure your Cloudflare security settings. Once live, you can start selling digital products and processing crypto payments. The NOWPayments platform will automatically convert the crypto payments to USD and store the order details in your Supabase account. With the Edge Commerce Stack, you'll also get SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured and end-to-end testing for a secure and reliable payment system.
